plan.title: Withdraw Dialog Closure via Alternate Actions

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ summary; this is the required starting state for a prepared case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the configured withdrawal visibility setting.
Allow withdrawal while the RFQ is live and accepting bids.
Open the RFQ stage before accessing its Responses tab and Settings menu.
Reach the RFQ Responses tab named in the scenario.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Withdraw to open the withdrawal dialog.
Dismiss the withdrawal dialog using the alternative keyboard action.
Verify that pressing Escape closes the withdrawal dialog without submitting the withdrawal.
Open the project overflow menu and choose Withdraw Project to test the second withdrawal entry point.
Dismiss the second withdrawal dialog using Escape.
Verify that the project-level withdrawal dialog is also closed without submitting the withdrawal.
